{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter to completed orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Step 2: Parse revenue and remove QA orders (revenue_numeric == 999999.99)
completed_only['revenue_numeric'] = completed_only['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
valid_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Verify: QA orders removed
print('QA order count after removal:', (valid_orders['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
# Conversion rate = proportion of converted == 1
conversion_rates = valid_orders.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract email and paid_search rates
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print results
print('Conversion rates by channel:\n', conversion_rates)
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}')"}
